coach_says: TSB is -55.5 and Garmin reports UNPRODUCTIVE with declining fitness, so this is a mandatory recovery week with total volume cut well below recent levels. The committed Tuesday MTB group ride is the single quality session; everything else is Zone 1-2, mobility, or rest, and the gym is dropped entirely to prioritise recovery. The aerobic-high shortage will be addressed with threshold work once TSB recovers above roughly -20.

days.details:
30 min | Objective: Active recovery and movement quality
Gentle flow focused on hips, hamstrings, thoracic spine and breathing. Keep effort minimal — the goal is to arrive fresh for Tuesday's committed hard MTB session.

90 min | Objective: Single quality session of the week (committed, non-negotiable)
Evening group ride — ride as the group dictates.
Given TSB of -55.5: skip any optional morning hard road ride this week, eat well beforehand, and do not add extra efforts beyond the group ride itself. Prioritise fuelling and sleep afterwards. Wet forecast contingency: substitute 60 min Zone 1 easy spin indoors.

40 min | Objective: Recovery from Tuesday (mandatory easy day)
40 min Zone 1, high cadence (90-100 rpm), flat route or trainer.
RPE 2 or lower — conversational throughout. If legs feel heavy or sleep was poor, replace with full rest or 20 min gentle stretching.

Warmup: 200m easy freestyle
Main: 4x150m (first 50m easy / next 100m smooth and relaxed), 20 sec rest
Cooldown: 100m easy
Total: ~1000m
Objective: Non-impact active recovery and variety. Keep every rep genuinely easy — no pace targets this week.

75 min | Objective: Easy aerobic maintenance (recovery week — no long ride)
75 min Zone 1-2, capped at low Zone 2.
Flat to rolling route, cadence 85-95 rpm, no surges on climbs.
RPE 3 max. Fuel normally and finish feeling better than you started.

60 min | Objective: Active rest and time off the bike
Relaxed walk or gentle hike at conversational pace. Optionally add 10-15 min of light stretching afterwards. Full rest is equally acceptable if fatigue remains high.

90 min | Objective: Aerobic base maintenance to close the recovery week
15 min Zone 1 warm-up
60 min steady low Zone 2, cadence 85-95 rpm
15 min Zone 1 cool-down
Strictly no intensity — if HRV or legs suggest lingering fatigue, shorten to 60 min or take full rest. Next week we reassess TSB and reintroduce threshold work to address the aerobic-high shortage.
